title: Code and processed data for: Data-Driven Joint Distance-Angle Path Loss Modeling for Short-Range Sub-THz LoS Links at 240-300 GHz
description: Reproducibility package for the 2026 IEEE Open Journal of the Communications Society article (DOI: 10.1109/OJCOMS.2026.3747701). Contains a self-contained Python implementation of five path-loss models (separable log-distance/quadratic-angle, 2-D cubic polynomial, MLP, Gaussian process with RBF kernel, Gaussian process with anisotropic Matern 5/2 kernel), validation scripts (pointwise LOO, leave-one-distance-out, leave-one-angle-out, simultaneous 50/80 cm holdout), the 153-point processed path-loss table derived from the public IEEE DataPort measurements of Karakoca et al., and archived evidence tables (fold predictions, fitted kernels, interval-reliability results, MLP sensitivity grid). The original third-party measurement files (Karakoca et al.; Tekbiyik et al.) and the SJTU simulation data are NOT redistributed; obtain them from their rights holders.
